entities.summary: Bhudev Mukhopadhyay was a writer and intellectual in 19th century Bengal. His works were considered ardent displays of nationalism and philosophy in the period of the Bengal Renaissance. His novel Anguriya Binimoy (1857) was the first historical novel written in Bengal.
